blind.B1: Yes. HFpEF (HFD + L-NAME) mice with vs without 8 weeks of treadmill running; GEO input RNA-seq libraries (3 HF, 3 HFEXT) carry the exercise factor; the 6 m6A IP libraries are a different assay (S2.1.p1, S2.7.p1, S2.8.p1).
blind.B2: HFpEF+EXT vs HFpEF, n = 3 per group, male C57BL/6J, heart (S2.8.p1, S3.4.p1 'n = 3 per group'). No healthy exercise arm.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one heart per mouse, separate animals per group; packet A lists no pairing key.
blind.B4: Two-group comparison only, DESeq2 (S2.8.p1 'Differential gene expression analysis was made with the DESeq2 R-package'); joint vs pairwise is moot with two groups.
blind.B5: S3.4.p1: '690 mRNAs, including 423 downregulated and 267 upregulated ... (FC > 2, p < 0.05; Figure 3B)'; raw p, fold change > 2 (strict), no FDR.

checks.evidence: Exercise arm HFEXT vs sedentary HF in input libraries; IP libraries excluded with reason (alignment gate).
grp HF 3 / HFEXT 3 matches paper n=3; HF40-input (no GSM) dropped with stated reason and recorded as discrepancy; control is the paper's sedentary HFpEF.
HFEXT vs HF, treatment vs control; Table 3 signs of 10 genes match the paper.
No repeated animals; packet A candidate keys: none.
Single two-group fit ~ grp; covers B4.
Only perfectly collinear columns are the group labels themselves (source_name, condition); one sex, one tissue, no batch recorded.
Matrix is FPKM (fractional, column sums ~1e6, Fig 3A) so limma on log2(FPKM+1) is the policy route; DESeq2 deviation declared; p-value histogram frac_p_gt_0.9 0.071 is healthy.
Paper rule raw p<0.05, FC>2 transcribed as pvalue<0.05 and |log2FC|>1, strict; padj audit reported. No alternative rule in packet B reproduces 690 (1538 at p<0.05 alone, 367 at |lfc|>0.585).
Same contrast (HFpEF+EXT vs HFpEF) compared; 97 vs 690 reported with route difference, no overclaim; gene-level sign concordance reported.
No stop or refusal; the 'no raw counts' statement only forces a declared method deviation (counts not in GEO supplementary).

human_items: Open policy: which threshold to report when the paper's 690 DEGs fit none of the tested rules; the large gap (97 vs 690) is attributed to FPKM/limma vs DESeq2 counts and the FPKM>=1 filter, not verified.
summary: 该案例分析了HFpEF运动组与久坐HFpEF组的input RNA-seq(3 vs 3),排除了m6A IP文库,方向、分组、阈值(原始p<0.05且FC>2)均与论文一致。因仅有FPKM,改用limma并已声明偏离,97 vs 690的差异被如实记录,未发现阻断或重大问题。
